newsitem.title: USA: Psychiatrist, wife slain in New Jersey.
newsitem.headline: Psychiatrist, wife slain in New Jersey.

text.p: Psychiatrist Dewitt Crandell and his wife, Marion, were found dead of multiple stab wounds Monday in their home in suburban Englewood, N.J., according to the Bergen County Prosecutor's office.
WCBS Radio was reporting that the suspect was the son of the victims, DeWitt Crandell Jr.
Mrs. Crandell, 63, was found in a downstairs hallway of their brick-and-fieldstone home, and her husband, who was 66, upstairs in a hallway.
There were signs of a struggle, but not of a forced entry, the prosecutor's office said.
